title: spec-dna.toml
description: The project configuration of spec-dna. spec-dna reads it as TOML. See docs/config.md.

spec-dna.description: The pinned spec-dna version. `check` does not run with a binary of another version.

profile.description: The profile of the project: the default severity of each diagnostic code. Default `standard`.

types.description: The document types of the project. A document of another type is an error (SD303), and `spec-dna new` does not accept it. Default: every type.

language.description: The language of the normative text: a BCP 47 language tag. A primary subtag other than `en` turns off the checks that read English word lists. Top level only. Default `en`.

change.description: The change process. Without this table the policy is `none`. With `none`, no check of the change process runs (SD905 and SD910 to SD926 are off, and no rule can turn them on).

policy.description: The change classes. With `none`, the codes SD905 and SD910 to SD926 are off and no rule can turn them on.

gate.description: The strictness of SD910. `block`: SD910 is an error. `warn`: SD910 is a warning. `off`: SD910 is off. Without the key, SD910 takes the severity of the profile. A rule of `[rules]` for SD910 has priority over the gate.

high-risk-layers.description: The names of layers of the graph. A delta line that targets a document of one of these layers makes the change higher-risk. Each name must be a layer of the graph. Default: `interfaces` and `rules`, without the names that the graph does not have.

high-risk-paths.description: Globs from the repository root. A plan or a diff that has a path that matches one of them makes the change higher-risk. Default: none.

shared-paths.description: Globs from the repository root: documents that each change can edit, such as a roadmap. SD913 does not report a path that matches one of them. Default: none.

max-fanout.description: The most requirement documents that one change can touch before SD905. Default 8.

max-task-files.description: The most paths that one task of an approved plan lists in its label `Files:` before SD924. An integer from 1 to 20. Default 3.

higher-risk-acceptors.description: The acceptor entries that the acceptance record of a higher-risk change needs (SD933). An integer from 1 to 3. Default 1. `init` writes 2 in the profile `strict`.

acceptance-for.description: The changes that need an acceptance record before `finish`. `none`: no change needs one by this key. `higher-risk`: a change with the class `higher-risk` needs one. `all`: each change that has a plan needs one. Without the key, the profile gives the value: `all` in `strict`, and `higher-risk` in `standard` and `lite`. `init` writes nothing. The value that the check reads is the stricter of the value in the head and the value in the tree of the base. In `lite` the codes of the record are off, so the key has an effect only with a rule that turns on the group `acceptance`.

invariants.description: Turns on the invariants of a spec. With `true`, `spec-dna new spec` writes the section `Invariants`, a spec lists there the rules that the change must keep true as `<doc-id>#<key>@<hash>`, SD936 and SD937 check the items, and the acceptance record answers each one (SD938). Without the key, a section `Invariants` is plain text. Default `false`. `init` writes `true` in the profile `strict`.

base.description: The name of a local branch. It is the base of the change checks when `--base` and `refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` give none. Use it in a repository with no remote. The name is not empty. It has no space and no `..`, and none of `~ ^ : ? * [ \`. It does not start with `-` or `/`, and it does not end with `/` or `.lock`. If the branch does not exist, the base is unknown, and the commands print a note. Without the key, there is no such base.

approval.description: Where an approval can be. `base`: only the base tree holds approvals, as in 0.6. `branch`: an approval commit of an approver in the branch also counts, if it comes before the work that it approves. `branch` needs a full git history (`fetch-depth: 0`) and a not empty `approvers`, and it is an error with `profile = "strict"`. Default `base`.

approvers.description: The author e-mails of the approval commits that count with `approval = "branch"`. The compare ignores case. Each item is not empty. List persons only: the address of an agent or a bot gives SD926. Required and not empty when `approval` is `branch`. Default: none.

areas.description: The areas of the project: the names of the folders of `requirements/`. Each name is one folder name. Two names that differ only in case are an error.

groups.description: Named sets of areas. Each area of a group must be in `areas`.

layers.description: The layer graph: one table for each layer. A project with no `[layers]` table gets the default graph for its types, without the layer `summaries` (`spec-dna layer add summaries` adds it). The `moves-to` edges must have no cycle, and a type is in one layer at most.

owners.description: The agent roles that must review a change that edits a path. Each key is a glob from the repository root, in the form of `[change] high-risk-paths`, and each value is a list of role names. When a glob matches a role path of a change, the change needs an acceptance record, and the record needs an entry that names each matched role in `roles` (SD933). A change needs the record also with `[change] acceptance-for = "none"`. The value that the check reads is the union of the table in the head and in the tree of the base. A role is `[a-z][a-z0-9-]*`, at most 40 characters. An entry `@<login>` or an e-mail names a person: 0.8.0 checks agent roles only, so the entry needs nothing and each command prints a warning. Another entry is an error. In `lite` the acceptance is off, so the table has no effect. `init` writes nothing.

dir.description: The folder of the project templates, relative to the repository root. Each file `<name>.md` has a `type` in its front matter. A file with the name of an embedded template replaces it. The folder is never part of a root. Default: `.spec-dna/templates`.

evals.description: The agent evals (ADR 0008): `spec-dna eval run` and the checks SD506 and SD918. No table means no evals. An eval is a file `<dir>/<id>.json`. See docs/config.md.

dir.description: The folder of the evals, relative to the repository root. It follows the rules of `templates.dir`. The folder cannot be the folder of `templates.dir`, hold it or be inside it. The folder is never part of a root. Default: `evals`.

min-pass-rate.description: The share of evals that must pass, from 0 to 1. Default 0.8.

runs.description: The runs of an eval that sets no `runs`, from 1 to 100. Default 3.

max-total-usd.description: The maximum spend of `eval run`, in USD, above 0. The command refuses a run with a higher estimate. It stops when the spend is above this value. Default 20.

tests.description: Globs of the test files where `check` reads `covers: <doc-id>#<key>` tags. An empty list turns the tags off. Default: the usual test directories and file names of common stacks.

reports.description: Globs from the repository root of the test report files (JUnit XML or the `spec-dna-report 1` line format). `spec-dna evidence stamp` stamps them, and `check --reports` and `finish` read them. A tag then proves a requirement only when a bound test case passed. An empty list turns the test reports off. Default: empty.

tree-exclude.description: Globs of the paths that the code tree leaves out, so that an edit of them does not make a test report stale. A list replaces the default. Default: each Markdown file (`**/*.md` and `**/*.markdown`).

reliable-runs.description: The passes of each bound test case that the level `reliable` needs, in the reports of one code tree. The runner runs the tests this many times and writes one stamped report for each run. An integer from 2 to 20. Default 3.

reliable-for.description: The changes whose requirements need the level `reliable` at `finish` (SD620): none, the changes of the class `higher-risk`, or all. A value other than `none` needs `reports`: without it, the configuration is an error (exit code 3). Default: none.

exclude.description: Repository path globs that are never documents (vendored or generated text). Links to them still resolve as files.

self-urls.description: URL prefixes that address this repository. A link under one of them resolves as a path from the repository root. `*` is one whole path segment, such as a branch.

install-source.description: The git source of spec-dna for `cargo install --git`, such as `file:///srv/git/spec-dna` or `ssh://git@host/team/spec-dna.git`. The message of a version mismatch uses it. Default: the public repository.

spec-dna-sha256.description: The SHA-256 sums of the release assets of the pin. A key is an asset name, `spec-dna-<version>-<target>`, with `.exe` for a Windows target. If the pin is the version of the binary, the binary also checks that each key is an asset of that version. Copy the table from `spec-dna-pin.toml` of the release.

roots.description: Directories of documents. A path belongs to the deepest root that contains it.

budgets.description: Size budgets in Unicode characters of body text, per document type.

growth.description: The number of characters that a document over its hard budget in the base can grow in one change. Growth up to this number gives a warning (SD703), not an error (SD702). Default 4000.

max-words.description: The maximum number of words in a requirement sentence. A longer sentence gives a warning. Default 30.

history-terms.description: The phrases that SD903 reports in a requirement. They replace the default phrases. An empty list gives no phrase. Each phrase is not blank, and the phrases are unique.

budget.description: The default character budget of `spec-dna context`. Default 8000.

conventions.description: For each type, pointers (`<doc-id or path>[#<anchor>]`) to the sections of project documents, or of Markdown files that are not documents (outside every root, or excluded), that state the conventions of the project for documents of that type. `context` serves them first when a target is a document of that type. `show --conventions <type>` prints them. A pointer that names nothing gives SD106.

repos.description: Aliases of other repositories for `<repo>:<namespace>/<slug>` references.

harness.description: The agent harness (ADR 0004): generic agent roles, and the files that `init` writes for Claude Code. No table is the same as level `none`. See docs/harness.md.

level.description: `none` installs nothing. `lean` installs the orchestrator, the advisor, the verifier, the researcher and the helper. `full` also installs the implementer and the code-simplifier. With `none`, spec-dna reads the other keys and ignores them.

deny.description: Tools that spec-dna removes from the `tools` list of each generated agent, and writes to `permissions.deny` of `.claude/settings.json`. A list that removes each tool of a generated agent is an error. Default: none.

context-meter.description: The context sizes, in tokens, at which the hook `context-meter` tells the main session its size. Ascending, each above 0. An empty list turns the main-session meter off. Default `[300000, 600000]`.

subagent-meter.description: The context size of a subagent, in tokens, at which the hook `context-meter` tells it its size. 0 turns it off. Default 250000.

fanout-cap.description: The number of agents that a workflow can start before the hook `fanout-cap` asks the person. 0 turns it off. Default 10.

skills.description: The skills of the workflow pack that `init` writes, each once. They are written in the order brainstorm, specify, clarify, write-plan, execute, tdd, review, verify, finish, debug, post-mortem. Default: none. The skill `review` also writes the agent file of the role `acceptor` where the acceptance is on. The names intent, spec and plan of 0.6 end: `spec-dna upgrade` renames them.

review-md.description: If true, `init` writes `REVIEW.md`, the review policy. Default false.

protect-tests.description: When the hook `protect-tests` asks the person before an edit of a test file that git tracks: `fix-branches` (on a branch whose name starts with `fix/`), `always` or `off`. Default `off`.

protect-approvals.description: If true, the harness writes the hook `protect-approvals`: it denies a `Bash` call that runs `spec-dna approve`, and a `git commit` that sets the status of an artifact of a change to its approval value. `init` writes true for the profile `strict`. Default false.

roles.description: The model and the effort of each role. A role that is not in the table takes its default. A role that the level does not include is an error.

claude-code.description: The model of the role for Claude Code: an alias (`opus`), a model id, `inherit` or `none` (the role is off). The orchestrator cannot be `none`.

fallback.description: The models of `fallbackModel`, in order. Default `["opus", "sonnet"]`. An empty list writes no `fallbackModel`.

claude-code.description: The model of the role for Claude Code: an alias (`opus`), a model id, `inherit` or `none` (the role is off). The advisor cannot be `haiku`, a model id with `haiku` in it, or `inherit`.

agent.description: The model of the `fallback-advisor` agent. `none` writes no agent file. Default `opus`.

claude-code.description: The model of the role for Claude Code: an alias (`opus`), a model id, `inherit` or `none` (the role is off).

The model of the role for Claude Code: an alias (`opus`), a model id, `inherit` or `none` (the role is off). The role has an agent file only with the skill `review` in `skills`, and not in the profile `lite`.
The model of the role for Claude Code: an alias (`opus`), a model id, `inherit` or `none` (the role is off).
The model of the role for Claude Code: an alias (`opus`), a model id, `inherit` or `none` (the role is off).
The model of the role for Claude Code: an alias (`opus`), a model id, `inherit` or `none` (the role is off).
The model of the role for Claude Code: an alias (`opus`), a model id, `inherit` or `none` (the role is off). `inherit` writes no `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL`.

efforts.description: The effort for each model alias, in `modelSettings` of `.claude/settings.json`. A `/model` switch uses it. Default `{ sonnet = "high" }`.

rootType.description: A type of a root or of `default-type`. The types `intent`, `spec` and `plan` are valid only in the `intent` layer, as `<dir>/<slug>/<type>.md`.

types.description: The document types of the layer. A type is in at most one layer.

dir.description: The folder of the layer, relative to the root. Default: the name of the layer. A layer with `files` has no `dir`, and no 2 layers have the same folder.

files.description: Top files of the layer, relative to the root. An entry has no `..`, no leading `/`, no `\` and no `:`. A layer with `files` has no `dir`, and no 2 layers have the same file.

paths.description: Globs, relative to the root. A document that matches belongs to this layer. The first layer in the file that matches wins.

moves-to.description: The layers that the text of this layer matures into. Each name is a layer of `[layers]`, and the edges have no cycle.

linked-from.description: Layers that can link to this layer, although they are more stable than it. Each name is a layer of `[layers]`.

max-docs.description: The most documents in the layer. Default: no limit.

max-chars.description: The most body characters in the layer. Default: no limit.

max-started.description: The most started changes. Default: no limit.

stale-days.description: The days without a commit before a change is stale. Default: no limit.

pattern.description: Literal text with exactly one `{n}` (one or more digits). `*` matches any text.

budget.description: The soft and hard budget of a document type, in Unicode characters of body text. `soft = 0` turns off SD701 and SD703. `hard = 0` turns off SD702 and SD704, and it needs `soft = 0`, because `hard` below `soft` is a configuration error. So `soft = 0` and `hard = 0` give the type no budget. The types `research` and `plan` have no default budget.

path.description: Directory relative to the repository root. Use `.` for the whole repository.

type.description: The type of every document in the root. With `mixed` (the default), the front matter, then the place of each document gives the type.

default-type.description: For mixed roots only: the type of a document that has no `type` field and a place that gives no type. No default: such a document gives SD303.

status.description: The status of a document that has the default type of the root and no `status` field.

exclude.description: Globs relative to the root that are not documents.

legacy-ids.description: Patterns that make aliases from the names of files, such as `ADR-{n}`.

legacy-keys.description: Patterns of requirement keys that spec-dna keeps as written, such as `R-{n}`.

status-map.description: Legacy status words, each with the status that it maps to, such as `released = "active"`. The target must be a status of the type of the root, or of any type in a mixed root.

required-sections.description: For each type, its required sections. The value is a list of headings (one required section, with alternative headings) or a list of such lists (several required sections). A document needs one heading of each list (SD305). The comparison ignores case. A value replaces the default of its type. An empty list removes the requirement. The defaults are: decision `["Decision Outcome", "Decision"]`, rule `["Rules"]`, incident `[["Summary"], ["Root cause"]]`, intent `["Intent", "Problem", "Summary"]`, spec `["Delta"]`, plan `["Files"]`. For a decision, `context` serves the first required section as the summary.

amendment-sections.description: For each type, the names of its amendment sections, in any language. A heading of level 2 or more starts an amendment section if it is a name, or if it starts with a name and a character that is not a letter or a digit. The comparison ignores case. The section continues to the next heading of the same or a higher level. A list replaces the default of its type. The default is `decision = ["Amendments"]`. After a decision is accepted, the text outside its amendment sections is locked (SD405). For a decision, `context` serves the amendment sections with the outcome.

live-sections.description: For each type, the names of its live sections, such as a progress section, in any language. They match as amendment sections do. A live section records a current state, so its text can change in place. In a decision, it is not locked text (no SD405), and new text in it gives no SD605. Default: `{ decision = ["Status"] }`.

history-sections.description: For each type, the names of its history sections (iteration logs, discussions, superseded notes). They match as amendment sections do. `spec-dna history` moves them, and the amendment sections of a decision, into a reference document. In a decision, a history section is not locked text.

companion-sections.description: For each type, the names of the sections that belong to the requirements, such as a coverage table. When `mv` moves requirements, the table rows and list items of these sections that name the moved keys move with them.

enforce-budgets.description: If false, a document over its hard budget gives the warning SD704, never the error SD702. Default true.

lint-severity.description: The rule `lint` of this root (SD801 to SD805), as in 0.1. `rules` has priority over it.

drift-severity.description: The rule `drift` of this root (SD606, SD607), as in 0.1. `rules` has priority over it.

profile.description: The profile of this root, if it differs from the project profile.

rules.description: Severity overrides for this root. They have priority over `[rules]` and over every profile.

Severity overrides. Each key is a rule group (references, ids, budgets, drift, evidence, reports, proof, acceptance, rollup, lint, layers, changes) or a diagnostic code such as `SD702`. A code rule has priority over a group rule. See docs/profiles.md.

harness-model.description: An alias, a model id, `inherit` or `none`.

harness-effort-main.description: The effort of the main model. `max` is not allowed.
